meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手切换到高强度工作模式,长时间专注推进复杂任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在难题上投入更多精力、持续而不半途而废
copy.tagline_en: Switch your assistant into a high-intensity mode to push through complex tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to invest more effort and keep going on tough tasks

howto.what: 激活后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:本回合首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,随后用 create_goal 登记目标、在临时文件里建追加式记事本、把计划写入文件并逐条登记 todo,再对交付物采集真实渠道证据。
howto.when: 当你要求进入 ultrawork 模式(如提到 ultrawork、ulw 等),且对话里还没有这份指令时,Claude 会读取它并进入该模式。

say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式给这个接口加一条校验规则
say.note: 会先登记目标,再动手并取证

say.text: ulw 模式:用真实浏览器验证这次改动
say.note: 会采集浏览器截图等证据

howto.what_en: Once activated, Claude works in ultrawork mode: the turn's first line is exactly ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then it registers a goal, opens an append-only notepad file, writes the plan with todos, and captures real-surface evidence.
howto.when_en: Read when you request ultrawork mode (e.g. you mention ultrawork or ulw) and this directive is not already in the conversation.

say_en.note: First line will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to add a validation rule to this endpoint
say_en.note: Registers a goal first, then works.

say_en.text: ulw mode: verify this change in a real browser
